name: portal2-chamber-fast
description: portal2-chamber at a fraction of its cost for shipped-map relights: a 4096 lightmap atlas with 256 samples (the directional RNM page uses 64), reflection probes at 128 samples, and a probe volume fitted to at most 50000 probes. Lightmaps are denoised per chart with OpenImageDenoise. Measured 2026-09-29 on sp_gi_chamber_01 (2048 atlas, gi-reference paths), 256 samples were within 1.7% luminance-weighted mean absolute error of a denoised 4096-sample bake at 1/16 of its cost. Since 2026-09-30, moving-light GI is out of scope: the bake does not produce radiosity transfer (RTRN), an SDF volume (SDFV), or relight bands for reflection probes. The indirect light is the bake's.
